en: An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a small industrial settlement and surrounding farmland in a hilly landscape. In the foreground and middle distance are several factory or mill buildings with chimneys, large residential houses, smaller village houses, roads and a pond; beyond them lie open fields and a forested ridge. The title "Marienberg i. S." is printed in red at the top left, and a small vertical printer's credit appears on the right edge.
